events.title: French Banks Had a Fine Quarter, But Wall Street Had a Feast
events.body: Europe's biggest lenders posted higher profits in Q1 but missed the trading boom that sent Wall Street's earnings through the roof

events.title: Crédit Agricole seals deal to acquire Ukraine-based Bank Lviv
events.body: Bank Lviv currently works with more than 37,000 individual clients and operates mainly in western Ukraine.

events.title: Credit Agricole Misses Q4 Profit as Costs Rise, Shares Slide Up to 5%
events.body: Higher Italian restructuring costs and elevated provisions weighed on earnings despite resilient asset gathering performance.

events.title: Credit Agricole SA (CRARF) Full Year 2025 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Client Acquisition ...
events.body: Credit Agricole SA (CRARF) reports stable net income and robust client growth, while navigating tax surcharges and market headwinds.

events_fr.title: Les banques francaises publient un bon trimestre mais Wall Street prend le festin
events_fr.description: Les plus grandes banques europeennes affichent des benefices en hausse au T1 mais ratent le boom du trading qui a propulse les resultats de Wall Street.

events_fr.title: Credit Agricole conclut l'acquisition de Bank Lviv en Ukraine
events_fr.description: Bank Lviv travaille actuellement avec plus de 37 000 clients particuliers et opere principalement dans l'ouest de l'Ukraine.

events_fr.title: Credit Agricole rate le profit T4 sous l'effet des couts : le titre recule jusqu'a 5 %
events_fr.description: La hausse des couts de restructuration en Italie et des provisions plus elevees pesent sur les resultats, malgre une bonne dynamique de collecte.

events_fr.title: Credit Agricole 2025 : forte acquisition de clients face aux vents contraires
events_fr.description: Credit Agricole (CRARF) affiche un resultat net stable et une croissance robuste de sa base clients, tout en absorbant des surtaxes fiscales et des vents contraires de marche.
